answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, with the stake slashed if peers prove duplicate or fake work. A single fake account then faces a real cost, while a violet-flagged cluster that shares funding, timing, or copied outputs loses its whole bond at once. The loss should ripple beyond one account: linked identities forfeit together, so creating thousands of copies no longer scales, and an attacker standing on the ledge of profitability falls back when the expected penalty exceeds the reward.
